title: simprep relaxation defaults (knowledge/relaxation.yaml)
description: Default protocol for the restrained local minimization of variant sites and the matched wild type (TASK-006). A study copies it into the manifest's `relaxation` and may edit it there; every output records the protocol it used.

enabled.description: Relax every variant and its matched wild type (TASK-006 decision 5).

mobile_shell_angstrom.description: Residues and waters with a heavy atom within this distance of a mutated residue form the mobile shell.

mobile_atoms.description: Side chains (not N, CA, C, O) of shell residues and whole shell waters move; everything else is fixed.

restraint_kj_per_mol_nm2.description: Harmonic positional restraint on mobile heavy atoms, except the mutated residue's side chain.

nonbonded_cutoff_nm.description: Also the distance within which a residue without a force-field template stops relaxation (TASK-006 decision 4).

platform.description: Double precision, single thread: byte-identical output (TASK-006 decision 7).
